rules.title: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled units (3/1/2026 - 2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: If you live in a rent-controlled unit in San Francisco, your landlord's annual rent increase effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 may not exceed 1.6% of your base rent. Multiply your base rent by .016 to find the maximum dollar increase.
rules.key_value: 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027; 1.4% for March 1, 2025 – February 28, 2026

coverage.summary: Rent-controlled units in San Francisco; the document does not specify which buildings are rent-controlled.

rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.

notes: Rent Board announcement of annual allowable increase figure. Document does not cite the ordinance section; citation S.F. Admin. Code § 37.3 is the governing Rent Ordinance section for annual increases. Effective date of the underlying rule not stated; figure dated in key_value.
